summary: game_dialogs 002 (Game3): recreate the item-upgrade art in the kit
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25, sheet by sheet: "001 - The kit should have all of these" (HH-0091); "002 - We can recreate those too"; "003 - Should already exist minus the glowing + - buttons - which we can add to the kit and recreate the rest"; "004 - The dialog can go as we can recreate it - but the rest can stay."; "005 - that's fine"; "006 - We can recreate that as well"; "010 - we can remove this entirely since the kit already includes that too".

Sheet 002 (InterfaceNdGame3) is used only by dialog_box_item_upgrade.cpp (frame 3 and others, as of 2026-11-25). User: "002 - We can recreate those too". Recreate its pieces with kit parts (or new kit pieces), move every use, then empty sprite 2 and archive 002.png.

**Done when:** every live use draws from the kit at the same place and with the same look, the sheet's retired frames are no longer loaded, retired images are archived byte-identical to working/archive/interface/game_dialogs/ with empty manifest placeholders, both builds are clean, and in-client screenshots of each affected dialog are attached.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** the user approved the before/after captures ("Both look good"). Review passed with no defects. Committed 8d76a6b2.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: User, 2026-11-25: "Those all can be runtime generated on the base form - the buttons just need added to the kit". So: the item-upgrade slot panel (002 frame 3), the sheet 003 pieces and the crusade dialog background are built at runtime from the kit's base form. The glowing +/- (003 frames 5/6) become new panel-kit pieces.

comments.author: client
comments.body:
Editor, 2026-11-25: done, awaiting PM review (guard dc245052).

- The item-upgrade slot panel (old Game3 frame 3, 81x115 at its pivot 94,132) is now a runtime panel-kit inset with the `leather` background, at the same place and size: `draw_item_slot()` in dialog_box_item_upgrade.cpp. The kit has no plain wood background; `leather` is the closest hue. Measured mean RGB of the interior: old 124,102,77; leather 110,90,64 (about 13 darker per channel, same hue). No kit art added or changed.
- The two redundant second draws (modes 1 and 6, the same opaque rect repainted) are dropped; the draw conditions per mode are unchanged.
- Sheet 002 retired: archived byte-identical to working/archive/interface/game_dialogs/002_2026-11-25.png (sha256 d9c1cc889e78139fa49fc93da5f992199194e8aff977eda374e7a91f461d52fc, source and copy match), manifest entry 2 replaced by the empty placeholder, 002.png git rm'd, index.json regenerated (`--check` ok, no change), load removed from screen_loading.cpp, InterfaceNdGame3 removed from sprite_id.h.
- Build: `-Target Game -Config Debug` clean (0 errors); client deployed (002.png removed from game/client). Server not rebuilt: no server or shared code changed, and the server was running.
- Captures (in-client, build/screenshots/): hh0093_before_full.png (old sheet, stone upgrade, empty slot); hh0093_after_full.png (same state, kit); hh0093_after_item.png (stone upgrade with an item); hh0093_after_in_progress.png (mode 2); hh0093_after_result.png (mode 3 success).
- Unverified: mode 1 (majestic/gizon upgrade) and mode 4 (failed) not shown in-client; they use the same helper call.
